findings.question: indicator L3: Is a cloud certification that requires immunity from non-EU law in force or adopted for government use?
findings.quote: La protection des données du service contre tout accès par des autorités publiques d'un Etat tiers non autorisé par le droit de l'Union européenne ou les engagements internationaux de la France.
findings.quote_english: Protection of the service's data against any access by public authorities of a third State not authorised by European Union law or France's international commitments.
findings.title: Décret n° 2026-272 du 14 avril 2026 relatif à la protection des données d'une sensibilité particulière ... traitées par un service d'informatique en nuage fourni par un prestataire privé
findings.note: Binding decree applying art. 31 of loi SREN: item 10 of article 2 lists this among the requirements of an ANSSI referential whose compliance is attested by a qualification; a T1 legal text newer than the doctrine page.

review.reason: Décret n° 2026-272 of 14 April 2026, in force, makes this item 10 of the security requirements that cloud services qualified for particularly sensitive administration data must meet: protection against access by third-state authorities not authorised by EU law. That is a non-EU-law immunity requirement in force for government use.

findings.question: Does a statute or binding regulation require government data (or classified government data) to be stored and processed under national or EU jurisdiction? yes = A statute or binding regulation requires it for government data generally; partial = Required only for classified data or only for named sectors; no = A source states there is no such requirement
findings.quote: veillent à ce que le service d'informatique en nuage fourni par le prestataire privé mette en œuvre des critères de sécurité et de protection des données garantissant notamment la protection des données traitées ou stockées contre tout accès par des autorités publiques d'Etats tiers non autorisé par le droit de l'Union européenne ou d'un Etat membre
findings.quote_english: shall ensure that the cloud service provided by the private provider implements security and data-protection criteria guaranteeing in particular the protection of processed or stored data against any access by public authorities of third States not authorised by EU law or that of a Member State
findings.title: Article 31 - LOI n° 2024-449 du 21 mai 2024 visant à sécuriser et à réguler l'espace numérique
findings.note: The obligation applies only when State administrations, operators and listed GIPs use private cloud for data of particular sensitivity (secrets protected by law, data needed for essential State missions), hence partial; implemented by décret n° 2026-272.

review.reason: Article 31 of Loi 2024-449 applies the third-state-access protection only to data 'd'une sensibilité particulière' (state secrets and data essential to core state functions), not to government data generally.
